svg.title: MeshDefend | Agentic Recovery
svg.desc: Editable vector recreation of the 1672 by 941 recovery dashboard. Recovery overview, recovery plan, dependency graph and service health. All typography is live editable text with embedded fonts. Status indicators, dependency signals and progress highlights loop continuously.
svg.metadata: Hand-authored native SVG shapes and paths. No raster content. No external resources. All motion is continuous and repeats indefinitely.

g.text: AI is coordinating the next best recovery actions
based on dependency and health signals.
Key relationships for a successful recovery.
